# Psalm 13 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For the music director. A psalm of David.

**2** How long, LORD? Will You forget me forever? How long will You look the other way?

**3** How long must I struggle with anguish in my soul, grief in my heart every day? How long will my enemy have the upper hand?

**4** Look at me! Answer me, LORD my God! Restore the sparkle to my eyes, or I will die.

**5** Don't let my enemy say, 'I have defeated him.' Don't let my foes rejoice at my downfall.

**6** But I trust in Your unfailing love. My heart rejoices in Your salvation. I will sing to the LORD because He is good to me.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **13:1-6**: Psalm 13 is the perfect miniature lament: complaint (vv.1-2), petition (vv.3-4), confidence (vv.5-6). Every element of the genre is present in just six verses.

— PNEUMA
